citations.claim: In muay thai, unlike Western boxing, fighters are not separated when they clinch, which is why knee and elbow strikes flow directly out of that position.
In some Krav Maga organizations, full-contact sparring is reserved for advanced students (G2 level, typically 4-6 years in), with earlier training being slow and light.
